rationale: Executive Order 13374 (March 14, 2005; 70 FR 12961) amends two sections of Executive Order 12293 and revokes Executive Order 13325. I read the held original and confirm that every operative sentence is a self-executing act with no continuing command, deferred date or duration, so the order's own commands were spent on issue; the three own-text records (amendment of section 4, strike-and-insert in section 2, revocation of EO 13325) were re-derived from the frozen original. The only current-law lead is the 22 U.S.C. 3901 note listing this order as an amender of EO 12293, which shows the amended text living in the parent and does not show this order in force. The catalog observation (Amends: EO 12293; Revokes: EO 13325) describes this order's own acts. The status therefore rests on the order's own terms: it has no operative force on 2026-10-14.
